Table 1705.2 Required Special Inspection of Steel Construction

For SI: 1 inch = 25.4 mm.

a A minimum of 10% of shear studs shall be verified for strength of welded connection. If failure is evident on one or more, then the strength of all shear studs shall be verified.

b. Welding of indirect and direct butt joints shall be continuously inspected.

(Am. L.L. 2023/077, 6/11/2023, eff. 6/11/2023)

Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2023/077.
